program_name: Business Consulting and Management (Curriculum in International Management)
teaching_language: Mixed programme: the official course page lists 'Language: English Italian', confirming Business Consulting and Management is delivered in both languages via separate curricula. Only the 'International Management' curriculum is English-taught; UNIME's official English-taught programmes listing (international.unime.it) includes only 'Business Consulting and Management (Curriculum in International Management)' among its Master's Degree Programmes, confirming that the other curriculum/curricula of this same course are Italian-taught and out of scope for English-medium applicants.
academic_requirements: Applicants must hold a bachelor's degree (laurea triennale/quadriennale), a three-year university diploma, or an equivalent foreign qualification recognised as suitable, plus the required curricular prerequisites (minimum credits, CFU) and adequate personal preparation. Minimum curricular requirement (as published, in Italian, on the course's own site): at least 104 CFU total across four disciplinary areas — business/management area (SECS-P/07, P/08, P/09, P/10, P/11, P/13, AGR/01): 34 CFU; economics area (SECS-P/01, P/02, P/03, P/06, P/12, MGGR/01, MGGR/02): 24 CFU; legal area (IUS/01, 04, 05, 06, 07, 09, 10, 12, 14): 24 CFU; mathematical-statistical area (SECS-S/01, S/03, S/04, S/05, S/06, MAT/05, MAT/06, INF/01, INF/05): 22 CFU. Enrolment 'with debits' (missing credits) is not permitted; missing credits must be acquired via single courses before matriculation. Personal preparation is verified via review of the applicant's academic record, potentially supplemented by an interview with the Department's Teaching Committee. Foreign qualification equivalence for these CFU/area requirements is assessed by the admissions Committee. University-wide Master's requirements (international.unime.it) also apply: high school diploma (12+ years) plus bachelor's degree (or official provisional certificate), with at least 15 years of total education required overall, and a transcript of records from the previous degree.
language_requirements: For the English-taught International Management curriculum, English proficiency at CEFR B2 is required per UNIME's university-wide English-taught programme policy: an International English Language Certificate (IELTS 5.5+, TOEFL iBT 72+, Cambridge English B2 First+, PTE General Level 3/B2+, or PTE Academic 59+, valid up to 2 years) uploaded to the application, unless the applicant is exempt (native speaker from a listed English-speaking country/territory, holder of a degree taught entirely in English from such a country, IB Diploma graduate in English, or taker of a standardised English-medium admission test used as an admission requirement). [uncertain: no course-specific English requirement text distinct from the university-wide policy was found on the programme's own cdl.unime.it site in English; the course's own Italian-language entry-requirements page did not restate a specific English threshold].
entry_exam_or_test: No standardised national admission test (e.g. TOLC) is indicated for this master's programme; entry is regulated instead through verification of curricular CFU prerequisites and 'adequate personal preparation,' assessed via review of the applicant's transcript/CV and, where needed, an interview with the Department of Economics' Teaching Committee (Comitato della Didattica). Applications overall are also assessed by a Departmental Commission per the university-wide master's admission process. [uncertain: whether a course-specific interview or CV-based selection is compulsory for every applicant or only when curricular records are ambiguous]
required_documents: High School Diploma obtained after at least 12 years of study
Bachelor's Degree diploma (or official provisional certificate if not yet issued; must show at least 15 years of total education across secondary + bachelor's study)
Transcript of records (exams taken in the previous degree programme), used to verify the minimum 104 CFU spread across business, economic, legal and mathematical-statistical areas
English language certificate (CEFR B2) for the International Management curriculum, or exemption declaration
CV / academic record for personal-preparation assessment (interview may be requested by the Department's Teaching Committee)
application_deadline_eu: For EU / No-Visa applicants, this Master's Degree (English-taught curriculum) falls under the university-wide 6th Call - No Visa Applicants: from 1 July 2026 (00:01 CEST) to 20 November 2026 (23:59 CET). [uncertain: no programme-specific EU deadline distinct from the university-wide call was found]
application_deadline_non_eu: Non-EU (Study VISA applicant) candidates apply in one of three sequential rounds covering English-taught & Italian-taught Bachelor's and Master's Degrees: 1st Call – Early Bird: 24 November 2025 (00:01 CET) to 22 December 2025 (23:59 CET); 2nd Call - Visa Applicants: 1 February 2026 (00:01 CET) to 31 March 2026 (23:59 CEST); 3rd Call - Visa Applicants: 13 April 2026 (00:01 CEST) to 10 May 2026 (23:59 CEST). A non-refundable EUR 30.00 application fee is due (covers up to two applications). Applications for English-taught programmes go through the UniME Application Portal; visa applicants must also register on the Universitaly portal, with the 2026/2027 Universitaly pre-enrolment deadline set at 1 September 2026.
